decision: Selected the EIA-860 plant coordinate of EIA plant 1573, Morgantown Generating Plant (Newburg, Charles County), the station TeraWulf acquired to host the Chesapeake Data Campus, as the campus locator.

owner_schedule.rows_for_plant_1573: generators 3, 4, 5 and 6, status OP, each 100% owned by Morgantown Power, LLC (Houston, TX)

facts.other_plants_named_morgantown: Morgantown Energy Facility and Morgantown L&D Hydroelectric Project (West Virginia), Morgantown Solar Park and Morgantown (Pennsylvania); none in Maryland besides plant 1573.
facts.coordinate_rounding: Four decimal places in the source (about 11 m in latitude, 9 m in longitude); stored here as published, rounded to 4 decimals.
facts.archive_note: eia8602025.zip is the final 2025 EIA-860 annual release linked from the EIA-860 page (released 10 September 2026); the 2024 zip link returned an HTML page and /archive/ is disallowed by robots.txt, so it was not used.
